```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(aod)

```

```{r}
msleep <-glimpse(msleep)
head(msleep)
storms<- storms
head(storms)
lizards <- lizards
head(lizards)
```



## Preguntas:


#### 1. 

```{r}
msleep %>%
  filter(awake >= 12)
```


#### 2. 

```{r}
msleep %>% mutate(percent_day_awake=(awake /24)*100) %>%
  dplyr::select(percent_day_awake,everything())
```

#### 3. 

```{r}
storms%>%
  group_by(year)%>%
  summarise(num_storms= n())
```

#### 4.

```{r}
storms%>%
  filter(wind >50) %>%
  arrange(desc(wind))
```

#### 5. 

```{r}
lizards%>%
  group_by(Site,Diameter)%>%
  summarise(highest_total_grahami=sum(grahami))%>%
  arrange(desc(highest_total_grahami))
```
